# DEC-00014 — Decision Trace
```text
DECISION TRACE DEC-00014

Objective:
Deliver Phase 4: the Next.js app (apps/web) as an enhancement layer over the zero-dependency core, consuming the SAME 31-route API as the offline console, without breaking the empty-node_modules invariant at the root.

Context:
TSK-00007 was the last stub task (Phase 4, weight 15%). DEC-00005 already chose the hybrid: core API + offline console + Next.js app sharing one contract. The source skeleton existed (layout, home, api client, config) but no dependencies, no routes beyond /, and no verification. The operator asked to finish the project.

Constraints:
- POL-0001: root package.json keeps dependencies {} forever; everything Next lives in apps/web
- SPEC rule 1: no direct database access from the front end — HTTP API only
- SPEC rule 2: no duplicated data shapes — the same contract the console renders
- The core suite must stay green with apps/web/node_modules deleted (offline invariant)
- Desktop AND mobile: responsive navigation without extra CSS frameworks

Alternatives considered:
A. Skip Phase 4 and declare the project finished at 92.5%  (rejected: The operator asked to finish; TSK-00007 is a real weighted task and the hybrid stack ("las 3") was an original acceptance criterion.)
B. Move the Next.js app to the repository root (single package.json)  (rejected: Pollutes the zero-dependency root, breaks the offline invariant and the empty-node_modules acceptance test.)
C. Deliver apps/web fully: 12 App-Router routes as server components, rewrites proxy for /api/*, conditional-skip test gates, production build verified against the live core  ← SELECTED

Decision:
Implement the 12 SPEC routes (dashboard, sessions + detail with RAW/processed split, decisions + detail with provenance, knowledge search with [[mark]] snippets, graph stats/hubs/nodes, timeline audit tape, context markdown, generated-docs index + traversal-safe reader) as dynamic server components sharing lib/ui.js. next.config rewrites proxy /api/* to GENESIS_API (baked at build time — documented in SPEC). tests/web-app.test.js: isolation tests always run; build/server gates skip honestly when deps or server are absent, and auto-detect a live :4000 server when present.

Justification:
The enhancement adds screens without adding contracts: zero new endpoints, zero reshaped payloads, zero root dependencies. 90/90 tests green with the server up (89+1 honest skip without it). next build produces 12 dynamic routes; curl verifies 200 + real data (92.5%, DEC-00013, FTS5 results) on every page, and /api/health through the proxy returns dependencies: 0.

Consequence:
Phase 4 complete → progress 100% of the weighted roadmap except the cross-cutting blocked TSK-00011 (mirror publication, waiting on a human with GitHub repo-creation permission). Running order: genesis serve (:3000) → GENESIS_API=... next build → next start (:4000). apps/web/node_modules and .next stay gitignored.

Status: APPROVED
```
